question: After runtime's verified byte-preserving nginx HIT-cache substrate (EXP-RUNTIME-35611612543: 960/960 byte-identical across HIT/SWR/SIE/304 with oracle-free greedy decode), does a controlled single-resource local perturbation (DOM attribute/text change, endpoint param/header change, Cache-Control/ETag mutation - one resource only) require only localized repair when measured with a real LLM agent (gpt-4o-mini same model/tools/budget 15 steps Playwright) and real verify() on actual DOM/response state: repair tokens <50% and browser interactions <40% vs cold re-exploration, verification AUROC>=0.75 and precision>=0.80, contamination<0.10 (no repair of unrelated resources), and amortized cost < cold at 10 reuses (retrieval+verification+repair amortized) vs COLD and retrieval baselines with trajectory-grouped CIs?
hypothesis: C-DELTA-REPAIR H1 (localized): a single-resource local perturbation is repairable by a localized patch (single selector rewrite, param slot rebind, header expectation update, or cache-key refresh = one registry mutation + 1-2 Playwright probes) without full-task re-exploration. Operational predictions: (P1) repair success (verify()=true AND independent oracle functional correctness) >=0.80 pooled and >=0.70 per family; (P2) mean repair LLM tokens <0.50 * mean B-COLD tokens AND mean browser interactions <0.40 * B-COLD AND mean verification steps <=2 (branch-derived sums of kernel.resolve/_bind/verify/freshness_check + browser actions, not a bijective formula); (P3) verification discriminates correct vs incorrect patch with AUROC >=0.75 and precision >=0.80 at frozen operating threshold (threshold fit on TRAIN perturbations only); (P4) contamination of unrelated mechanisms (N>=20 distinct intents/endpoints) <0.10; (P5) amortized per-use cost at 10 reuses (repair_tokens + verify_tokens + 10*retrieval_tokens)/10 < mean B-COLD tokens and same for browser interactions, with trajectory-grouped bootstrap CIs.
falsifier: C-DELTA-REPAIR is FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING (in this localhost nginx HIT-cache setting) if ANY primary locality condition fails while validity gates pass: (F1) pooled repair success <0.80 or any family <0.70; (F2) mean repair tokens >=0.50 * mean B-COLD tokens OR mean browser interactions >=0.40 * B-COLD OR mean verification steps >2; (F3) contamination >=0.10; (F4) verification AUROC <0.75 OR precision <0.80 at operating threshold; (F5) amortized per-use cost at 10 reuses >= B-COLD cost. Falsification requires C1-C3 validity gates to pass. Family-specific failure (e.g., DOM passes but ENDPOINT fails) bounds the ceiling to MIXED (per-family) rather than globally confirming or globally falsifying. Any failure of C1-C3 validity gates yields MEASUREMENT_INVALID, not falsification.

baselines.description: Full cold re-exploration: same real LLM agent (gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18, temp 0.0, seed 42, max 15 steps, 4096 tokens, identical Playwright toolset goto/click/fill/evaluate/fetch) solves the task from scratch with empty registry and no prior trajectory. Measures honesttokens (sum prompt+completion via API usage), browser interactions (count Playwright actions), wall-time, and verify() calls. This is the denominator for P2/P5; must use branch-derived sums, not 250+500*10*novelty bijective proxy.
baselines.expected: Succeeds on >=90% unperturbed tasks at full cost (baseline 100%). Repair must be <50% tokens and <40% browser steps to claim locality. Provides success_rate_cold for comparative margin.

baselines.description: Semantic retrieval (embedding search over prior trajectory memory, nearest successful trajectory replay, no patch). Strong retrieval baseline that Graph must beat to justify repair mechanics over RAG. Same model/tools/budget for any LLM-assisted retrieval reranking; retrieval cost measured as retrieval_tokens (embedding + rerank) + retrieval_browser (if any fetch).
baselines.expected: Partial success: retrieves correct trajectory family but fails on stale locator/header without local patch (expected 20-40% success). Repair should exceed retrieval by >=0.30 absolute success margin with trajectory-grouped CI.

baselines.description: Verbatim mechanism/route replay without repair: pre-perturbation stored mechanism executed unchanged on post-perturbation target via kernel.resolve/_bind with original params. Zero-patch 0-token replay baseline (TERX/BrowserBash class).
baselines.expected: Near 0% success post-perturbation (correctly fails). Demonstrates perturbation is breaking and replay alone insufficient. If replay success >0.10, perturbation was non-breaking and instance is excluded as validity failure.

baselines.description: Oracle hand-authored minimal patch (single selector/param/header correction applied by experimenter, 1 registry mutation + 1 browser probe + 1 verify()). Upper-bound ceiling for achievable localized repair with honest cost measurement.
baselines.expected: 100% success with 1-2 browser probes. Measured repair should approach oracle within 2x tokens/steps. Provides cost floor and verifies repair is possible when correctly specified.

baselines.description: Runtime verified substrate invariant: oracle-free decompression (Content-Encoding handling without oracle) yields 960/960 byte-identical decompressed bodies across HIT, SWR (stale-while-revalidate), SIE (stale-if-error), and 304 Not Modified stages on unperturbed resources. Dependency from EXP-RUNTIME-35611612543; recomputed SHA256(decompressed_body) HIT==SWR==SIE==304 pre-perturbation.
baselines.expected: >=0.99 byte identity pre-perturbation (allow 1% tooling jitter, 960/960 target). If <0.99, C-MEAS-VALID substrate has drifted and packet is MEASUREMENT_INVALID per Director mandate rationale. Post-perturbation, perturbed resource must differ while unperturbed resources remain identical (proportional check on 36-instance subset).

positive_control.description: PC1: Unperturbed execution — mechanism resolved via kernel.resolve() and verify()=true on pre-perturbation endpoint with no patch, byte identity 1.0, success 1.0. PC2: Known-break single-attribute perturbation with oracle patch — Flask+nginx testbed where target DOM id #submit-123->#submit-124 (D1) and endpoint param ?id=->?item= (E1) each with oracle patch updating single selector/param; repair succeeds within 2 browser probes and verification passes, cost ratio <0.50 vs B-COLD. Both PCs use real LLM+Playwright+verify path, not simulated costs. PC1 100% and PC2 >=90% required for C1 validity.
positive_control.expected: PC1 3/3 success, byte identity 1.0. PC2 >=90% success (Wilson lower >=0.70) with cost ratio <0.50 tokens and <0.40 browser. If either fails, instrumentation is broken (MEASUREMENT_INVALID), not hypothesis evidence.

null_control.description: NC1: Zero perturbation (identical pre/post resource) — repair pipeline must produce zero patch (repair cost 0, contamination 0, verify no false patch) and byte identity 1.0 across all cache stages. NC2: Distant unrelated perturbation (mutate endpoint B while target is endpoint A) — repair of A must be no-op, success on A unchanged, contamination on B-independent mechanisms remains 0. Both tested with permutation-shuffled repair decisions (random patch proposal) to verify false-accept detection; random-patch AUROC should be ~0.50.
null_control.expected: NC1 repair cost 0, NC2 contamination 0, both false-accept 0%. Random-patch verification precision <0.50 and AUROC 0.45-0.55 (near chance). If NC1 cost >0 or NC2 contamination >0 or random-patch false-accept >0.05, repair pipeline is miscalibrated (MEASUREMENT_INVALID).

measurement_validity: Substrate provenance: nginx reverse-proxy with HIT/SWR/SIE/304 caching (Cache-Control max-age, stale-while-revalidate, stale-if-error), Flask backend with PyJWT HS256 auth if auth perturbation used, decompression via oracle-free path (raw Content-Encoding handling, not oracle), verified pre-perturbation SHA256(decompressed_body) HIT==SWR==SIE==304 on >=0.99 of instances. Record nginx.conf hash, Flask testbed_server.py commit, decompression code hash, nginx/Playwright/Python versions. If runtime fixture unavailable, reproduce equivalent localhost fixture or mark MEASUREMENT_INVALID (do not invent byte identity). Dependency on EXP-RUNTIME-35611612543 disclosed; if byte identity recomputation <0.99, halt as MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

Perturbation isolation (single-resource): each instance mutates exactly one local resource — one DOM node attribute (id/class/data-testid) OR one text node OR one endpoint query param/header name OR one response header (Cache-Control max-age value, ETag value). No global config, no auth migration, no multi-resource drift. Perturbation manifest records file, line, old/new value, blast radius=1 resource, and excludes instances where B-REPLAY success >0.10 (non-breaking). Cross-condition contamination checked by re-reading unrelated resources.

Pre/post registry snapshot isolation: registry cloned before perturbation; repair operates on clone; contamination measured as delta on uninvolved mechanism set (N>=20 unrelated mechanisms, distinct intents). No leakage of perturbation description into repair prompt beyond post-state observation (no oracle label). Repair agent sees only pre-perturbation mechanism + post-perturbation page/response observation + verify() signal (result of kernel.verify on actual DOM/response).

Cost measurement transparency (anti-bijective): tokens = sum(prompt+completion) for repair LLM calls (record model id gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18, temp 0.0, seed 42, max 15 steps, 4096 tokens), browser interactions = count(Playwright actions: goto, click, fill, evaluate, fetch), verification cost = count(verify()+registry lookup+HIT-cache fetch), wall-time measured. Full re-exploration cost measured with identical budget/metrics via same agent loop. All costs branch-derived sums of kernel.resolve/_bind/verify/freshness_check + browser steps; the 250+500*10*novelty proxy and hardcoded confidences are explicitly rejected and must not be used. Trajectory (perturbation instance) is the grouping unit for all CIs.

Verification validity: kernel.verify(mechanism_id, observed_state) checks postconditions (_matches) on actual response/DOM state, not on expected label. False accepts measured as verify()=true but independent oracle functional check fails (oracle script uses ground-truth selector/param to assert functional correctness). AUROC/precision computed on repair correctness labels (oracle) vs verify() score/confidence. Threshold calibrated on TRAIN perturbation split only (3 families, leave-one-family or 50/50 split); post-state never leaks into pre-state features for threshold fitting. Report AUROC, precision, recall, ECE, and confusion matrix.

Adequacy: >=30 perturbation instances (target 36 = 3 families x 2 variants x 6 seeds; minimum 30 if LLM budget constrained, with per-family n>=10) and >=20 unrelated mechanisms for contamination and >=10 reuse amortizations. Each family has independent success/cost reported; pooled only when family is homogeneous. If any family has n<10 or total n<24, mark as underpowered exploratory and downgrade ceiling (not CONFIRMED).

Determinism and inference validity: fixed seeds for perturbation generation, nginx cache key generation, and LLM repair (seed 42 where supported via hashlib.sha256 for perturbations, OpenAI seed param for LLM); all hashes use hashlib.sha256, never Python hash(); record commit, Python version, nginx version, Playwright version, OpenAI model version. Exclude flaky network/external sites — localhost nginx+Flask only. Uncertainty via trajectory-grouped bootstrap (5000 resamples, seed 42, resampling perturbation instances, not individual steps) for rates, cost ratios, and AUROC; Wilson CIs for rates also reported. If OPENAI_API_KEY absent or Playwright not installed or rate-limited, record as MEASUREMENT_INVALID infrastructure failure, not falsification (per EXPERIMENT_PACKET s9).

Byte-identity recomputation: for each instance, store SHA256(decompressed_body) for HIT,SWR,SIE,304 pre and post; pre-perturbation HIT==SWR==SIE==304 required at >=0.99; post-perturbation HIT body for perturbed resource must differ from pre (mutation detected, Hamming>0) while unperturbed resources remain identical at >=0.99 (proportional check). Oracle-free decompression code path preserved from runtime fixture and hashed.
decision_rule: All thresholds applied on frozen pre-registered data only, using trajectory-grouped inference (perturbation instance as unit). Compute per-instance metrics then aggregate with 95% trajectory-grouped bootstrap CIs (5000 resamples seed42) and Wilson CIs for rates. Validity gates (must ALL pass for any CONFIRMED/FALSIFIED claim; else MEASUREMENT_INVALID): (C1) PC1 success==1.0 (3/3) and PC2 repair success >=0.90 (Wilson lower >=0.70) with cost ratio <0.50 vs B-COLD; (C2) NC1 cost==0 and NC2 contamination==0 and random-patch false-accept <=0.05 with AUROC 0.45-0.55; (C3) B-BYTE-IDENTITY pre-perturbation byte identity >=0.99 and post-perturbation perturbed resource differs while unperturbed remain >=0.99. Primary gates (require ALL to CONFIRM localized repair): (C4) repair success rate >=0.80 pooled (Wilson lower >=0.65) AND >=0.70 per family (Wilson lower >=0.50); (C5) mean repair tokens <0.50 * mean B-COLD tokens (bootstrap 95% upper <0.50) AND mean browser interactions <0.40 * B-COLD (bootstrap upper <0.40) AND mean verification steps <=2.0; (C6) contamination <0.10 (Wilson upper <0.15); (C7) verification AUROC >=0.75 (bootstrap lower >=0.65) AND precision at operating threshold >=0.80 (bootstrap lower >=0.70); (C8) amortized per-use cost at 10 reuses (repair+verify+10*retrieval)/10 < mean B-COLD cost for both tokens and browser (bootstrap 95% upper <1.0). CONFIRMED if C1-C8 all PASS. FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING if any of C4-C8 fails while C1-C3 PASS (valid negative). MEASUREMENT_INVALID if any of C1-C3 fails OR total n<24 OR any family n<10 and pooled would otherwise confirm (downgrade). MIXED if >=1 family passes C4-C8 while another fails — report per-family ceilings, do not pool.
product_consequence_positive: If CONFIRMED, C-DELTA-REPAIR advances from HYPOTHESIS to EXPERIMENTAL (VALIDATED bounded to single-resource localhost nginx HIT-cache only) on 3 families. Justifies product architecture with localized repair boundaries: registry patch + verify loop rather than full task replay, with amortized advantage after 10 reuses. Next steps: expand perturbation radius (2-3 resources, cross-page), test on distributed Redis session store, and integrate repair into SpiderKernel.invalidate()+distill() with freshness guard. Promotion to Product Core NOT authorized — localhost only, single model (gpt-4o-mini), synthetic single-resource perturbations; requires cross-site replication and multi-model generalization before SHIPPED.
product_consequence_negative: If FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING, single-resource locality fails even under minimal perturbations, closing the smallest repair hypothesis on this substrate. Product must default to full re-exploration or fused RAG+re-exploration for any drift, budgeting repair as equivalent to cold cost; do not ship a repair layer that would cause contamination/false accepts. Delta-repair claim remains HYPOTHESIS (blocked for broader radius). Graph lane should then pivot per Director comparative reasoning to C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY with matched families or C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE with abstention calibration, both of which do not assume cheap local patches. Runtime HIT-cache substrate remains valid for measurement but not sufficient for repair. A valid negative is high information — prevents premature promotion and informs amortization economics.
estimated_cost: Low-Medium: reuse runtime nginx+Flask fixture (0.5h setup, verify 960/960 byte identity), generate 36 perturbation instances (0.5h, hashlib seeds), run B-COLD with real LLM+Playwright on 36 instances (1.5h, gpt-4o-mini 15 steps, ~36*15*~800 tokens ~432K tokens), run repair+verify loop per instance with same agent (1.5h), run B-RAG/B-REPLAY/B-ORACLE (0.5h), compute byte identity+contamination+AUROC with trajectory-grouped bootstrap (0.5h), analysis (0.5h). Total ~5.5h wall-time, ~0.8-1.2M tokens, all localhost, no external sites. If OPENAI_API_KEY absent, halt as MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
expected_information_gain: Very high: first honest-cost measurement of C-DELTA-REPAIR with real LLM agent + real verify() on actual DOM/response state (0/271 canonical experiments before this thread had such; prior EXP-GRAPH-35741890679 used simulated costs). Directly tests SPIDER's core product promise 'pay novelty not whole task' with repair boundaries, strong 0-token replay baseline, contamination and 10-reuse amortization economics, and verified byte-preserving substrate dependency. Either CONFIRMED (justifies repair architecture, unblocks residual-novelty amortization and product economics) or FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING (exposes cheapest possible repair is not cheap even with oracle-free HIT-cache, prevents premature promotion) materially changes claim state and next allocation for graph/runtime/product. Advances beyond 45-experiment C-PARAM-INHERIT MEASUREMENT_INVALID basin and 30-streak FRESHNESS saturation (r~0.002-0.046) which had diminishing marginal return; Director PIVOT rationale satisfied. Trajectory-grouped CIs and honest branch-derived costs ensure result is not a tautology (rho~1.0 bijective proxy rejected).
